title: Account Security Ruling: Absorption of Takeover-Card Liability by Personal Account Plan
content:
**Ruling.** This ruling covers the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card. On a dispute of a purchase on a *takeover card*, a virtual card the cardholder says they never created, the liability the customer keeps depends on the plan of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account and on how soon the takeover lock followed the card's issue.

- **Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit, lock placed no more than 1 calendar day after the takeover card's issue date.** Pocketwire absorbs the whole open liability, and the liability kept is zero.
- **Pocketwire Plus or Pocketwire Prime, lock placed no more than 1 calendar day after that issue date.** Pocketwire absorbs up to 10.00 of it. The liability kept is the open liability less 10.00, and never below zero.
- **Every other case.** The liability kept is the open liability.

**Terms used in this ruling**

- *Takeover lock*: the security lock recorded on the linked Pocketwire Personal Account for suspected account takeover. The day it was placed is taken from the moment the lock was placed, as shown on that account.
- *No more than 1 calendar day after the issue date*: the lock was placed on the takeover card's issue date or on the next calendar day. A lock placed 2 or more days after issue, or placed before the card was issued, does not meet this.
- *Open liability*: the recorded customer liability of the unauthorized disputes filed on the takeover card, less that of the ones already resolved.
- *Linked plan*: the plan shown on the linked Pocketwire Personal Account. Pocketwire Lite and Pocketwire Core fall under "every other case".

### Plan and timing table (hypothetical open liability of 50.00)

| Linked plan | Lock placed | Liability kept |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Onyx | on the issue date | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Summit | 1 day after issue | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 1 day after issue | 40.00, which is 50.00 less 10.00 |
| Pocketwire Plus | on the issue date, with an open liability of 6.00 | 0.00, because 6.00 less 10.00 is below zero |
| Pocketwire Summit | 2 days after issue | 50.00 |
| Pocketwire Core | on the issue date | 50.00 |
| Pocketwire Lite | 1 day after issue | 50.00 |
